name: grpc
title: gRPC
description: Expose gRPC endpoints and access external gRPC endpoints.
label: rpc

properties.name: host
properties.description: The gRPC server host name. This is localhost or 0.0.0.0 when being a consumer or remote server host name when using producer.

properties.name: port
properties.description: The gRPC local or remote server port

properties.name: service
properties.description: Fully qualified service name from the protocol buffer descriptor file (package dot service definition name)

properties.name: flowControlWindow
properties.description: The HTTP/2 flow control window size (MiB)

properties.name: forwardOnCompleted
properties.label: common
properties.description: Determines if onCompleted events should be pushed to the Camel route.

properties.name: forwardOnError
properties.label: common
properties.description: Determines if onError events should be pushed to the Camel route. Exceptions will be set as message body.

properties.name: maxMessageSize
properties.description: The maximum message size allowed to be received/sent (MiB)

properties.name: autoDiscoverServerInterceptors
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Setting the autoDiscoverServerInterceptors mechanism, if true, the component will look for a ServerInterceptor instance in the registry automatically otherwise it will skip that checking.

properties.name: consumerStrategy
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: This option specifies the top-level strategy for processing service requests and responses in streaming mode. If an aggregation strategy is selected, all requests will be accumulated in the list, then transferred to the flow, and the accumulated responses will be sent to the sender. If a propagation strategy is selected, request is sent to the stream, and the response will be immediately sent back to the sender. If a delegation strategy is selected, request is sent to the stream, but no response generated under the assumption that all necessary responses will be sent at another part of route. Delegation strategy always comes with routeControlledStreamObserver=true to be able to achieve the assumption.

properties.name: initialFlowControlWindow
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Sets the initial flow control window in bytes.

properties.name: keepAliveTime
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Sets a custom keepalive time in milliseconds, the delay time for sending next keepalive ping. A value of Long.MAX_VALUE or a value greater or equal to NettyServerBuilder.AS_LARGE_AS_INFINITE will disable keepalive.

properties.name: keepAliveTimeout
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Sets a custom keepalive timeout in milliseconds, the timeout for keepalive ping requests.

properties.name: maxConcurrentCallsPerConnection
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: The maximum number of concurrent calls permitted for each incoming server connection. Defaults to no limit.

properties.name: maxConnectionAge
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Sets a custom max connection age in milliseconds. Connections lasting longer than which will be gracefully terminated. A random jitter of /-10% will be added to the value. A value of Long.MAX_VALUE (the default) or a value greater or equal to NettyServerBuilder.AS_LARGE_AS_INFINITE will disable max connection age.

properties.name: maxConnectionAgeGrace
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Sets a custom grace time in milliseconds for the graceful connection termination. A value of Long.MAX_VALUE (the default) or a value greater or equal to NettyServerBuilder.AS_LARGE_AS_INFINITE is considered infinite.

properties.name: maxConnectionIdle
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Sets a custom max connection idle time in milliseconds. Connection being idle for longer than which will be gracefully terminated. A value of Long.MAX_VALUE (the default) or a value greater or equal to NettyServerBuilder.AS_LARGE_AS_INFINITE will disable max connection idle

properties.name: maxInboundMetadataSize
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Sets the maximum size of metadata allowed to be received. The default is 8 KiB.

properties.name: maxRstFramesPerWindow
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Limits the rate of incoming RST_STREAM frames per connection to maxRstFramesPerWindow per maxRstPeriodSeconds. This option MUST be used in conjunction with maxRstPeriodSeconds for it to be effective.

properties.name: maxRstPeriodSeconds
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Limits the rate of incoming RST_STREAM frames per maxRstPeriodSeconds. This option MUST be used in conjunction with maxRstFramesPerWindow for it to be effective.

properties.name: muteException
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: If enabled and an Exchange failed processing on the consumer side the status description returned to the client won't contain the exception's message.

properties.name: permitKeepAliveTime
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Sets the most aggressive keep-alive time in milliseconds that clients are permitted to configure. The server will try to detect clients exceeding this rate and will forcefully close the connection.

properties.name: permitKeepAliveWithoutCalls
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Sets whether to allow clients to send keep-alive HTTP/ 2 PINGs even if there are no outstanding RPCs on the connection.

properties.name: routeControlledStreamObserver
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Lets the route to take control over stream observer. If this value is set to true, then the response observer of gRPC call will be set with the name GrpcConstants.GRPC_RESPONSE_OBSERVER in the Exchange object. Please note that the stream observer's onNext(), onError(), onCompleted() methods should be called in the route.

properties.name: bridgeErrorHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: exceptionHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: exchangePattern
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

properties.name: autoDiscoverClientInterceptors
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Setting the autoDiscoverClientInterceptors mechanism, if true, the component will look for a ClientInterceptor instance in the registry automatically otherwise it will skip that checking.

properties.name: inheritExchangePropertiesForReplies
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Copies exchange properties from original exchange to all exchanges created for route defined by streamRepliesTo.

properties.name: method
properties.label: producer
properties.description: gRPC method name

properties.name: producerStrategy
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The mode used to communicate with a remote gRPC server. In SIMPLE mode a single exchange is translated into a remote procedure call. In STREAMING mode all exchanges will be sent within the same request (input and output of the recipient gRPC service must be of type 'stream').

properties.name: streamRepliesTo
properties.label: producer
properties.description: When using STREAMING client mode, it indicates the endpoint where responses should be forwarded.

properties.name: toRouteControlledStreamObserver
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Expects that exchange property GrpcConstants.GRPC_RESPONSE_OBSERVER is set. Takes its value and calls onNext, onError and onComplete on that StreamObserver. All other gRPC parameters are ignored.

properties.name: userAgent
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The user agent header passed to the server

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: synchronous
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Sets whether synchronous processing should be strictly used

properties.name: authenticationType
properties.label: security
properties.description: Authentication method type in advance to the SSL/TLS negotiation

properties.name: jwtAlgorithm
properties.label: security
properties.description: JSON Web Token sign algorithm

properties.name: jwtIssuer
properties.label: security
properties.description: JSON Web Token issuer

properties.name: jwtSecret
properties.label: security
properties.description: JSON Web Token secret

properties.name: jwtSubject
properties.label: security
properties.description: JSON Web Token subject

properties.name: keyCertChainResource
properties.label: security
properties.description: The X.509 certificate chain file resource in PEM format link

properties.name: keyPassword
properties.label: security
properties.description: The PKCS#8 private key file password

properties.name: keyResource
properties.label: security
properties.description: The PKCS#8 private key file resource in PEM format link

properties.name: negotiationType
properties.label: security
properties.description: Identifies the security negotiation type used for HTTP/2 communication

properties.name: serviceAccountResource
properties.label: security
properties.description: Service Account key file in JSON format resource link supported by the Google Cloud SDK

properties.name: trustCertCollectionResource
properties.label: security
properties.description: The trusted certificates collection file resource in PEM format for verifying the remote endpoint's certificate
